repository.description: Where the source lives, when that is somewhere other than the main link. A project gets one entry, so this is how it links both.

openSourceNote.description: Why openSource is false when the entry is hosted on a source forge. Required in that case, because 'the code is right there' is the reader's default reading of a repository link.

updatedAt.description: When the entry's content last changed. 2026-06-25 on most records means the initial bulk import, not a review.

lastReviewedAt.description: When a person last opened this site and confirmed the entry still describes it. Required on anything not left over from the import.

tags.description: Facet vocabulary. Every value must appear in tags.json, which only admits a tag three or more entries share. An entry with no shared facet carries none, and is still reachable by category and by keywords.

keywords.description: The descriptive long tail: terms too specific to be a facet, but the words someone would actually search for. Fed to search at the same weight as tags.

linkStatus.description: What npm run check:links last saw at this URL. An observation, not a verdict: 'blocked' means a bot wall refused the checker and says nothing about whether the page is there.

lastCheckedAt.description: When the link checker last reached this URL. Not lastReviewedAt: a check says the URL answered, a review says a person confirmed the entry still describes it.

acceptedRedirect.description: A permanent redirect a curator looked at and decided not to follow, usually a locale or marketing path where the URL on file is the better canonical. The checker reports ok while the destination matches this, and goes back to reporting moved the day it changes.

checkDisabled.description: Why the link checker skips this entry. A string rather than a boolean, because a permanent exemption needs a reason someone can disagree with later.
